newsitem.title: USA: AmEx has new unit to market its cards -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AmEx has new unit to market its cards -WSJ.

text.p: American Express Co has created a division that will focus exclusively on getting banks to use its charge and credit cards, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Tuesday.

The company has complained about rules by competitors Visa and MasterCard International that bar their member banks from also issuing American Express cards, a matter that the Justice Department is investigating.
Jim Cracchiolo, the American Express executive heading the new division, told the paper his unit's efforts don't depend on changing competitors' practices in the U.S., but is instead a global effort.
